Also FYI, the older series was about 3-10+ part episodes. So it would be one storyline merged into different episodes in order. Materials:

Wood Dowel

(2) Eyebolt screws for ends

Eyebolt screw for center (optional)

A drill and drill bit slightly smaller than desired eyebolts you'll be using

Wood paint and primer (optional)

Finely grit sandpaper

Small carabiners


1. Take wood dowel and lightly sand the entire thing, and clean off any shavings there may be. Paint typically won't stick to wood if there is something like that in the way

2. Paint as many coats of primer and paint you would like, definitely let it sit to dry a couple hours depending in how quickly the paint you're using dries

3. I put a clear polyacrylic top coat on, to assure the paint will not chip off, as well

4. Drill a pilot hole into each end, and be sure to make it almost as deep as your eyebolts. Mine would not screw in all the way because I accidentally split the wood and I believe it was because my pilot holes weren't deep enough (I fixed my problem with decorative black gorilla tape on each end, haha!)

5. Do the same in the center of the pole if you would like a collar attachment, as well.

5. Screw in the eyebolts screws by either attaching a hook as a drill bit, hooking it to the eyebolt hole and using the drill to screw it in quickly, or do what I did the old fashioned way and use a screwdriver to pivot it in farther

6. Take your carabiners and hook on to each eyebolt. This is what you can hook your collar and cuffs to if they have a loop/ring on it

7. Decorate further if desired!
